name: @sauce/names
description: The class a chain's tokens are instances of: an ERC-20 token. The SDK writes one module per chain from its registry whose tokens are instances of these, and hands it to every program compiled for that chain as an ambient module. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (names.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because a Solana token is a mint's key, with no token methods.
